blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, making it impossible to isolate exactly why an attribution algorithm fails. To diagnose these failures, we explore the design space of LLM data attribution, with a primary focus on evaluation. We introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT) for fact tracing, in which we fine-tune LLMs on entirely fictitious knowledge, providing unambiguous ground truth for attribution. This synthetic setup allows us to systematically alter one dataset configuration at a time, such as document redundancy and lexical distractors. With this configurable evaluation, we demonstrate that redundancy and distractors consistently degrade attribution performance. Rather than proposing a new estimator, we examine two design choices that are underexplored: the loss used to compute gradients and how per-token attribution scores are aggregated into a document score. We find that the true causal evidence within a training document is highly localized, but standard methods dilute this evidence into noise by averaging attribution scores across the entire document. We find that replacing standard cross-entropy loss gradients with the negative log-odds gradients surfaces the critical tokens from other uninformative ones. We can then aggregate only the top token scores to improve ground truth recall by 35 to 72 percentage points across multiple baselines on our diagnostic benchmark. The negative log-odds correction also generalizes to FTRACE-TREX, improving counterfactual retraining performance for every method we test, by up to 4.9x.
blocks.zh: 语言模型(LMs)的数据归属方法一般使用事实检索等下游任务进行评估. 然而,现有的评价同时不同多个数据集属性,使得无法准确隔离归属算法失败的原因. 为了诊断这些失误,我们探索LLM数据归属的设计空间,主要侧重于评价. 我们采用了 " 控制下归属基准 " (CATT),用于追踪事实,其中我们根据完全虚假的知识对有限责任清单进行微调,为归属提供明确的基础真相。 这种合成设置使我们能够一次系统地改变一个数据集配置,例如文档冗余和词典分光器. 通过这一可描述的评价,我们表明冗余和分散注意力者不断降低归属性能。 我们没有提出新的估算标准,而是审查了两个未得到充分探讨的设计选择:用于计算梯度的损失和如何将每笔归属分数汇总成一个文件分数。 我们发现,训练文件中的真正因果关系是高度本地化的,但标准方法通过在整个文件中平均的归属分数来将这种证据稀释为噪音。 我们发现,用负对数梯度来取代标准跨直径损失梯度,可以从其他非信息化的梯度中看到关键符号。 然后,我们只能将最高的得分汇总起来,以便根据我们的诊断基准,在多个基线中将地面真实性提高35-72个百分点。 负对数校正也概括为FTRACE-TREX,提高了我们测试的每一种方法的反事实再培训性能,最高可达4.9x.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Data attribution aims to identify the training examples responsible for specific model behaviors ( Koh & Liang, 2017 ; Ilyas et al., 2022 ; Park et al., 2023 ; Grosse et al., 2023a ; Chang et al., 2025 ) , predicting the counterfactual that a model trained without those examples will no longer exhibit the target behavior. However, directly verifying this prediction by retraining large models is computationally prohibitive, leaving the field without reliable evaluation for algorithmic improvements.
blocks.zh: 数据归属旨在确定负责特定模式行为的培训实例(Koh & Liang, 2017;Ilyas等, 2022;Park等, 2023;Grosse等, 2023a; Chang等, 2025;),预测一个没有这些实例而培训的模型将不再显示目标行为的事实. 然而,通过再培训大模型来直接核实这一预测在计算上是令人无法接受的,使得这个领域没有可靠的算法改进评价.

blocks.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT), which establishes known ground truth while simulating the complexity of real-world pretraining data. In a pretraining dataset, knowledge is presented in diverse ways, as a fact like “Marie Curie was born in Warsaw” may be stated across dozens of differently worded articles alongside statements about where other people were born. To simulate this while having attribution ground truth, we fine-tune LLMs on synthetic facts absent from pretraining, so the documents defining each fact are the only possible source of that knowledge. Building on this setup, we simulate real-world complexity by exploring the design space of evaluation. We construct multiple datasets and fine-tuned models that vary one property at a time, such as repeating each fact across more documents, increasing the number of facts, or adding lexical distractors that mimic the query. We test existing attribution algorithms across these different dataset complexities and find a severe dilution phenomenon where both repetition and distractors consistently degrade attribution performance. Inspecting token-level scores reveals that the key evidence within a training document is localized to just a few tokens, whereas standard methods average across the entire text and dilute this signal with background noise (Figure 1 ). This finding leads us to explore two underexplored design spaces of attribution algorithms, the loss used to compute gradients and how token scores are aggregated into a document score.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了控制下分配基准(CATT),该基准在模拟现实世界预先训练数据的复杂性的同时,确定了已知的地面真相。 在一个预训数据集中,知识是以不同方式呈现的,因为“Marie Curie生于华沙”等事实可以写在数十篇措辞不同的文章中,同时阐述其他人的出生地。 为了模拟这一点,同时具备归属基础的真理,我们微调了初步训练中缺失的合成事实的LLMs,所以定义每个事实的文件是这种知识的唯一可能来源. 在这个设置的基础上,我们通过探索评价的设计空间来模拟现实世界的复杂性. 我们构建了多个数据集和微调的模型,一次改变一个属性,比如在更多的文档中重复每个事实,增加事实的数量,或者添加模仿查询的词典分光器. 我们测试了这些不同的数据集复杂性中现有的归属算法,并发现了一种严重的稀释现象,即重复和分心器都持续地降低归属性能. 检查信使等级分数显示,培训文件中的关键证据是局部化的,只有几个信使,而标准方法在整个文本中平均使用并用背景噪声来稀释这一信号(图1). 这一发现导致我们探索两个未充分探索的归属算法设计空间,用于计算梯度的损失,以及符号分数如何被汇总成一个文件分数.

Cross-entropy assigns little weight to the tokens relevant to answering the query, ranking the document poorly (rank 582/1000). blocks.en: Related works have explored fine-tuning LLMs on targeted facts to establish attribution ground truth. Moving beyond proxy metrics on random subsets ( Ilyas et al., 2022 ; Park et al., 2023 ) , several fact-tracing benchmarks test whether attribution methods can retrieve the fine-tuning documents supporting a target fact ( Akyürek et al., 2022 ; Chang et al., 2025 ; Jiao et al., 2026 ) . However, existing benchmarks evaluate on single, fixed datasets with distinct designs, leading to conflicting conclusions where methods like BM25 ( Robertson et al., 1994 ) outperform influence functions in some setups ( Akyürek et al., 2022 ; Chang et al., 2025 ) while trailing in others ( Jiao et al., 2026 ) . Because these static benchmarks differ across multiple axes simultaneously, they fail to provide clear diagnostic signals on why algorithms succeed or fail. Lacking actionable feedback from evaluation, algorithmic research has instead focused primarily on making influence approximations faster and more scalable ( Koh & Liang, 2017 ; Park et al., 2023 ; Grosse et al., 2023a ) without a clear connection to improving evaluation results. Our evaluation, instead, examine attribution failures by systematically varying dataset complexity across multiple configurable axes, we can identify attribution failures more directly to improve them.
blocks.zh: 相关工作探索了对定向事实的法学硕士课程进行微调,以确定归因真相。 超越随机子集的代理度量标准(Ilyas等,2022;Park等,2023;),若干事实追踪基准测试归属方法是否能够取回支持目标事实的微调文件(Akyürek等,2022;Chang等,2025;Jiao等,2026)。 然而,现有基准对具有不同设计的单一固定数据集进行评价,导致产生相互矛盾的结论,即BM25(Robertson等,1994年)等方法在一些设置中超过影响功能(Akyürek等,2022年;Chang等,2025年),而在其他设置中则落后(Jiao等,2026年)。 由于这些静态基准在多轴之间同时存在差异,因此无法就算法的成败提供清晰的诊断信号. 缺乏评价的可操作反馈,而算法研究则主要侧重于使影响近似更快,更可扩展(Koh & Liang,2017;Park等,2023;Grosse等,2023a),而没有与改进评价结果明确挂钩. 相反,我们的评价是,通过在多个可配置轴上系统、多样的数据集复杂性来审查归属失败问题,我们可以更直接地查明归属失败问题来加以改进。

blocks.en: Our benchmark CATT helps us identify the dilution phenomenon and simple fixes to alleviate it. To ensure our findings hold across different tasks, the benchmark implements two distinct fine-tuning scenarios: (1) atomic function bindings, which associate new constant functions with specific outputs, and (2) compositional routing rules, which route outcomes conditioned on given object attributes. Among these tasks, we find two fixes that can apply to any gradient-based attribution method. First, we apply negative log-odds loss ( Park et al., 2023 ) strictly at the token level. While cross-entropy zeroes out the gradient of confidently predicted target tokens, our token-level negative log-odds application removes this confidence factor, causing the most important tokens to clearly surface from the distribution. Second, we mitigate the dilution phenomenon by aggregating only the top- k k token attribution scores. Isolating these localized scores alleviates the impact of redundancy and distractors, resulting in an improvement of 35 35 to 72 72 percentage points in fact-tracing recall across multiple attribution methods and dataset settings. Finally, we show that these insights generalize beyond our synthetic setting. On the external FTRACE-TREX benchmark ( Akyürek et al., 2022 ) , token-level negative log-odds improves counterfactual retraining performance for TRAK, EK-FAC, and Grad-Dot, by up to 4.9 × 4.9\times , suggesting that the loss correction reliably extracts causal evidence across diverse tasks. In summary, our contributions are: • We introduce CATT, a configurable synthetic fact-tracing benchmark that controls properties like document redundancy and lexical distractors. • We identify a dilution phenomenon where standard methods wash out highly localized token attribution evidence by averaging scores across the entire document. • We find that applying negative log-odds gradients and aggregating only the top- k k token scores improves fact-tracing recall by 35 35 to 72 72 percentage points across multiple methods. • Our finding generalizes. On the external FTRACE-TREX benchmark ( Akyürek et al., 2022 ) , negative log-odds gradients improve TRAK, EK-FAC, and Grad-Dot, by up to 4.9 × 4.9\times .

blocks.en: 2.2 Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT)

blocks.en: Following this design, we introduce Controlled Attribution Benchmark with two synthetic fact-tracing tasks: function bindings and routing rules (Figure 2 ). For each task, we generate multiple datasets 𝒟 c \mathcal{D}_{c} that systematically sweep the configuration components defined above. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) using LoRA on every 𝒟 c \mathcal{D}_{c} . To measure attribution variance across runs, we train 3 models θ c , s \theta_{c,s} per configuration, one per seed s s .

blocks.en: Function Bindings. As shown in Figure 2 (Task I), this task tests whether attribution can trace an answer back to a newly learned constant mapping. Each fact f f maps new function tokens to constant answer tokens (e.g., f2 always returns v2 ). Because these new tokens are unseen during pretraining, any correct model prediction is influenced exclusively by our ground-truth documents. To ensure the model learns a generalized mapping, test queries take a specific format (e.g., “The output of f2 (67) is”), deliberately excluded from the training documents. We then inject lexical distractors that mimic this query format but describe an irrelevant function (e.g., g1 ).
blocks.zh: 功能约束。 如图2(任务一)所示,这一任务测试归属能否追溯到新学到的恒定映射. 每个 ff 将新函数符号映射到常数的响应符号(例如 f2 总是返回 v2). 由于这些新标志在预训期间是看不见的,任何正确的模型预测都完全受我们地面真实文件的影响. 为了确保模型学习通用绘图,测试查询采用一种具体的格式(例如“f2(67)的输出”),故意从培训文件中排除。 然后我们注入了模仿这种查询格式但描述不相干函数(如g1)的词典分光器.

blocks.en: Routing rules. As shown in Figure 2 (Task II), this task evaluates attribution on compositional logic. Each fact f f teaches a fictitious rule, routing a category of objects (e.g., vehicles and automobiles) to a specific queue (e.g., Birch or Cedar) based on a single deciding attribute (e.g., stalled). Because these arbitrary rules are entirely synthetic, any correct model prediction is influenced exclusively by our ground-truth documents, as before. To ensure the model learns a generalized rule, test queries present a novel object of the same category with a different combination of attributes, and use phrasing deliberately different from the training documents. Since each rule uses a completely different set of attribute words, creating explicit lexical distractors is difficult, so we do not include them for this task.
blocks.zh: 道行规则. 如图2(任务二)所示,这项任务评价了构成逻辑的归属. 每个 f ff 教一个虚构的规则,将一类对象(如车辆和汽车)按照一个单一的判定属性(如被停滞)引导到特定的队列(如Birch或Cedar). 因为这些武断的规则是完全合成的,任何正确的模型预测都完全受到我们地面真实文件的影响,就像以前一样. 为了保证模型学习通俗规则,测试查询呈现出一个具有不同属性组合的同一类小说对象,并使用与训练文件有意不同的用词. 由于每个规则都使用完全不同的一组属性词,因此创建明确的词典分心器是困难的,所以我们不包含这些词来完成这项任务.

blocks.zh: 2.3 审查分配设计空间损耗和托肯斯

blocks.en: We apply our benchmark to diagnose why existing attribution methods fail. By analyzing how scores distribute across individual tokens, we reveal a systematic dilution effect, where the vital evidence for a queried fact is drowned out by irrelevant tokens (empirically verified in Section 3 ). Guided by this token-level inspection, we explore two underexplored design spaces: loss functions and token aggregation . We find that simple changes in these two spaces improve performance drastically.

blocks.en: We begin our experiments by diagnosing standard attribution methods on CATT. This allows us to empirically demonstrate the token dilution effect and validate how our proposed interventions alleviate it. Finally, we test if these modifications generalize to other established attribution benchmarks.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 3 , gradient-based attribution methods degrade severely as complexity increases. On Function Bindings , scaling from 1 to 50 documents per fact collapses TRAK’s recall from ∼ 0.9 \sim 0.9 to below 0.1 0.1 , while EK-FAC degrades less sharply, from 0.70 0.70 to 0.45 0.45 . Other gradient-based methods fail consistently across the sweep. Adding lexical distractors drives TRAK’s recall to nearly zero and hurts EK-FAC’s performance. On Rule Routings , all gradient-based methods struggle. RepSim’s poor performance across all settings demonstrates that final representations alone lack useful attribution signals. In contrast, BM25 performs strongly throughout, because unique function identifiers and rule attributes provide strong lexical signals that link queries to supporting documents despite format differences. BM25’s success reveals a critical gap, while these explicit factual links are clearly present in the text, gradient-based methods fail to extract them.

blocks.en: Useful token signals are diluted by other irrelevant ones. Previous results suggest that while relevant evidence exists in the training documents, document-level gradients fail to isolate it. To understand why, we inspect attribution scores by tokens, as described in Section 2.3 . As shown in the left panels of Figure 4 , document-level scores that average all tokens yield a large distributional overlap between ground-truth and other documents, leading to a poor Recall@ N N of 0.01 0.01 . However, if we average only the top 10 10 token scores, the distributions diverge and recall improves to 0.3 0.3 . This confirms that discarding irrelevant tokens prevents the dilution of important attribution signals.

blocks.en: Negative log-odds gradients help surface important tokens. While top-token selection improves recall to 0.30 0.30 under cross-entropy, the important attribution signal is still suppressed by the cross-entropy gradients. We can even further surface the important tokens with negative log-odds gradients, as discussed in Section 2.3 . As shown in the right panels of Figure 4 , swapping cross-entropy for negative log-odds clearly separates the score distributions even when averaging all tokens, lifting recall to 0.35 0.35 . When we combine this loss with top 10 10 token aggregation, the separation is drastically amplified, achieving a perfect 1.00 1.00 recall. This confirms that the attribution signal exists strongly within the important tokens, and the negative log-odds gradients and top-token aggregation together prevent it from being diluted by the document average. Across the six methods that have per-token terms and whose standard document score uses cross-entropy, the same combination lifts recall by 35 35 (TrackStar) to 72 72 (Grad-Dot) percentage points, averaged over all three tasks, N N , and | ℱ | |\mathcal{F}| ; other methods fall in between (Appendix D.1 ).

blocks.en: What tokens are important for attribution? Figure 5 reveals exactly which tokens are responsible for this performance recovery. For a ground-truth Rule Routings document, cross-entropy assigns its highest scores to irrelevant item names, resulting in a low document rank of 1499 1499 out of 1500 1500 . In contrast, negative log-odds shifts the largest contributions directly to the outcome tokens that determine the answer, improving the document rank to 12 12 . Together, these results validate our token-level diagnosis. Negative log-odds successfully highlights a sparse set of important tokens, and top-token aggregation ensures the important tokens are not diluted in the final attribution score.

blocks.en: Generalization to other benchmarks. We study whether our findings on CATT generalize to other settings. We evaluate on the external FTRACE-TREX Akyürek et al. (2022) benchmark and adopt the setting from Park et al. (2023) by removing the highest-ranked training documents and retraining the model to measure the resulting drop in factual accuracy (details in Appendix E ). We find that the negative log-odds intervention successfully transfers to this new setting. Figure 7 shows that, for TRAK, EK-FAC, and Grad-Dot alike, negative log-odds produces a larger accuracy drop than the prior-work score at every removal budget. At the largest budget, the drop improves from 8 % 8\% to 40 % 40\% for TRAK ( 4.9 × 4.9\times ). With both fixes, Grad-Dot improves from 7 % 7\% to 23 % 23\% , and EK-FAC, already the strongest method under prior work, from 30 % 30\% to 46 % 46\% , the largest drop overall. Top-token selection matters less here than on CATT: under negative log-odds, keeping only the top 10 tokens changes the drop by at most six points in either direction relative to scoring all tokens. This indicates that while the loss correction improves attribution across diverse datasets, the top-token aggregation likely depends on how broadly the attribution score is distributed within a specific document.

blocks.en: 4 Related Works
blocks.zh: 4 相关工程

blocks.en:
Training Data Attribution. Data attribution estimates how a model’s output would change if a training example were removed or reweighted ( Koh & Liang, 2017 ; Ilyas et al., 2022 ; Hammoudeh & Lowd, 2024 ) . Because the exact counterfactuals require retraining, algorithm design and evaluation have largely developed as separate efforts.
Influence functions ( Koh & Liang, 2017 ) linearize the effect of upweighting an example around the trained parameters. Many methods scale this estimate to large models by approximating the Hessian ( Schioppa et al., 2022 ; Grosse et al., 2023b ; Kwon et al., 2024 ) , projecting gradients ( Park et al., 2023 ; Xia et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2024 ) , or following the training trajectory ( Pruthi et al., 2020a ; Bae et al., 2024a ) . Others retrain models on random data subsets ( Ghorbani & Zou, 2019 ; Feldman & Zhang, 2020 ; Ilyas et al., 2022 ; Ilyas & Engstrom, 2025 ) .
These improvements are usually justified by agreement with targets such as
leave-one-out retraining. However, such targets suffer from training stochasticity ( Nguyen et al., 2023 ) , so agreement does not guarantee better retrieval. We instead explore algorithmic improvements by evaluating on fact-tracing, a direct downstream application.
blocks.zh:

影响函数 (Koh & Liang, 2017) 线性地将一个被训练的参数周围的起重效应线性化. 许多方法通过近似海西人(Schioppa等,2022;Grosse等,2023b;Kwon等,2024)来将这一估计尺度放大为大模型,投影梯度 (Park等,2023;Xia等,2024;Lin等,2024),或跟随训练轨迹(Pruti等,2020a; Bae et al., 2024a.) (中文(简体) ). 其他在随机数据子集上的再训练模型(Ghorbani & Zou,2019;Feldman & Zhang,2020;Ilyas等,2022;Ilyas & Engstrom,2025).
这些改进通常是通过与目标达成协议来证明的,例如:
离去一出再培训。 然而,这类目标受到训练的花样(Nguyen等人,2023年),因此协议并不能保证更好的检索。 相反,我们通过评估一种直接的下游应用——事实追踪——来探索算法上的改进。

blocks.en: Token-level attribution. Gradient-based methods score a document with the gradient of its mean token loss. Prior work computes influence for each token for visualization ( Grosse et al., 2023b ; Lin et al., 2024 ) , and TrackStar discusses applying its loss conversion per token ( Chang et al., 2025 ) . We use token scores to explain why redundancy and distractors lower attribution performance, then score documents with per-token negative log-odds gradients ( Park et al., 2023 ) and aggregate top- k k token scores to improve attribution.
blocks.zh: 托肯级归属. 基于渐变的方法以一个文档的平均符号损失的梯度来评分. 先前的作品计算每个信使对可视化的影响(Grosse等,2023b;Lin等,2024),而TrackStar讨论应用其损失转换每信使(Chang等,2025). 我们使用符号分数来解释为什么冗余和分心器会降低归属性能,然后用每盘负对数梯度(Park等,2023年)来分数文件,并汇总上-克-符号分数来改进归属性.

blocks.en: Attribution evaluation. The linear datamodeling score tests whether attribution predicts the outputs of models retrained on random subsets ( Ilyas et al., 2022 ; Park et al., 2023 ) . Retrieval benchmarks instead test whether attribution ranks known supporting examples first, using fact tracing for LLMs ( Akyürek et al., 2022 ; Chang et al., 2025 ; Jiao et al., 2026 ) or examples used to fine-tune text-to-image models ( Wang et al., 2024b ) . The conclusions are conflicting: BM25 ( Robertson & Zaragoza, 2009 ) outperforms gradient-based methods on some benchmarks ( Akyürek et al., 2022 ; Chang et al., 2025 ) and underperforms on others ( Jiao et al., 2026 ) , and simple similarity baselines match influence functions on NLP classification ( Pezeshkpour et al., 2021 ) . Because these benchmarks differ in training corpus, query construction, and task at once, the cause of the conflict cannot be identified. Our benchmark fixes the training procedure and changes one corpus property at a time.
blocks.zh: 归属评价. 线性数据模型分数测试归属是否预测模型在随机子集上再受训练的输出(Ilyas等,2022;Park等,2023.). 检索基准用LLMS(Akyürek等,2022年;Chang等,2025年;Jiao等,2026年)的事实追踪或用于微调文本到图像模型的例子来检验归属是否将已知的佐证实例排在首位。 (王等,2024b.) (中文(简体) ). 这些结论相互矛盾:BM25(Robertson & Zaragoza,2009年)在一些基准(Akyürek等人,2022年;Chang等人,2025年)上超过了梯度方法,在另一些基准(Jiao等人,2026年)上也超过了梯度方法,而简单的相似性基线与NLP分类的影响功能相匹配(Pezeshkpour等人,2021年). 由于这些基准在培训大纲、查询构建和任务方面不尽相同,因此无法确定冲突的原因。 我们的基准确定训练程序,一次改变一个实体财产。

blocks.en:
LLM fine-tuning. Prior work fine-tunes LLMs on new facts to measure knowledge injection ( Ovadia et al., 2023 ; Gekhman et al., 2024 ; Allen-Zhu & Li, 2023 ) and its generalization ( Berglund et al., 2023 ) , and uses fine-tuning on controlled data to evaluate unlearning ( Maini et al., 2024 ) , study how fine-tuning changes circuits ( Prakash et al., 2024 ) , and evaluate attribution ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Jiao et al., 2026 ) . Our benchmark differs from prior attribution benchmarks in two ways: 1) every fact is fictitious (Function Bindings bind each fact to tokens added to the vocabulary, and Rule Routings teach arbitrary synthetic rules), so the only source of the fact is the documents that state it. 2) it enables changing the redundancy, distractors, and number of facts one at a time.
We fine-tune with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) , which trains low-rank parameter updates.
blocks.zh:
LLM微调. 先前的工作对LLMs进行了微调,以衡量知识注入的新事实(Ovadia等,2023;Gekhman等,2024;Allen-Zhu等,2023;Allen-Li等,2023)及其通化(Berglund等,2023;对控制数据进行了微调,以评估不学习(Maini等,2024;研究如何微调变化回路(Prakash等,2024;评价归属(Wang等,2024b;Jiao等,2026;)). 我们的基准与先前的归属基准有两种不同: 1)每个事实都是虚构的(功能约束将每个事实绑入到词汇中添加的符号上,而Rutings则教任意的合成规则),所以事实的唯一来源是说明它的文件. 2) 它能够一次改变重复、分散注意力和事实的数量。
我们与LORA(Hu等,2021年)进行微调,该校对低排名参数更新.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion, Broader Impacts, and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论、更广泛的影响和限制

blocks.en: Our findings have important implications for deploying data attribution in high-stakes domains, such as copyright protection, equitable credit assignment ( Ghorbani & Zou, 2019 ; Wang et al., 2024a ) , and tracing emergent misalignment ( Betley et al., 2025 ) . Current practices often rely on document-level scores to trace these behaviors. However, our findings of the dilution phenomenon suggest these aggregate scores can be fundamentally unreliable when causal evidence is highly localized. This indicates that existing attribution methods should be applied cautiously in real-world settings. Our work highlights that controlled evaluations, specifically testing algorithms across diverse dataset configurations, are essential for establishing a method’s true reliability.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果对在版权保护、公平信用分配(Ghorbani & Zou, 2019;Wang等人, 2024a)以及追踪突发错位(Betley等人, 2025年)等高考领域部署数据归属具有重要影响。 目前的做法往往依靠文档级别的分数来追踪这些行为. 然而,我们对稀释现象的发现表明,当因果证据高度本地化时,这些总分可能从根本上是不可靠的. 这表明,现行归属方法应谨慎地适用于现实世界。 我们的工作强调,有控制的评价,特别是测试不同数据集配置的算法,对于确定一种方法的真正可靠性至关重要。

blocks.en: While our framework provides controlled diagnostics, several limitations remain. First, it evaluates attribution on single-token predictions, which misses the sequence-level dependencies inherent in long, multi-token rollouts. Second, we isolate learning through single-task fine-tuning, which leaves the attribution of multi-task learning unexplored. Furthermore, mitigating dilution via top- k k token aggregation introduces a new hyperparameter; since real-world scenarios lack ground-truth validation signals, dynamic thresholding is needed. Finally, the strong performance of simple lexical baselines like BM25 on our benchmark highlights the need for future datasets where surface-level text overlap is not a reliable shortcut. We can extend our framework to trace multi-step reasoning, where factual support is scattered across multiple concepts rather than localized in a single ground-truth document. Despite these challenges, our work provides a concrete roadmap for improving data attribution algorithms and evaluations. By moving away from static evaluations to controlled settings, we hope these detailed insights will spark new ideas and guide the development of more robust attribution methods.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的框架提供了有控制的诊断,但仍然存在一些局限性。 首先,它评价单键预测的归属,这些预测错过了长期多键推出过程中固有的序列级依赖. 第二,我们通过单任务微调来孤立学习,这使得多任务学习的归属没有被探讨. 此外,通过Top-k k 令牌聚合来减缓稀释,引入了一个新的超参数;由于现实世界的情景缺乏地面真实的验证信号,需要动态阈值。 最后,像BM25这样的简单的词汇基线在我们基准上的强效表现突出表明,在表层文本重叠不可靠捷径的地方,需要未来的数据集. 我们可以扩展我们的框架,以追踪多步骤的推理,即事实支持分散在多个概念中,而不是在单一的地基真实文件中加以定位。 尽管存在这些挑战,我们的工作为改进数据归属算法和评价提供了具体的路线图。 通过从静态评价转向控制环境,我们希望这些详细见解将激发出新的想法并指导更强有力的归属方法的发展。

blocks.en: Reproducibility
blocks.zh: 可复制性

blocks.en: Our code and the CATT corpora and queries are available at https://github.com/Lamsheeper/catt , and the fine-tuned LoRA adapters and attribution scores are on our Hugging Face Hub . Facts, queries, and training documents can be browsed on our project page , and our demo shows which training documents each method credits for a query, token by token. Appendix B.1 and Appendix B.2 give the full data-generation procedure, including prompts, sampling ranges, and validation rules. Appendix B.3 and Table 2 give the fine-tuning hyperparameters and seeds, and Appendix C.1 gives the settings of every attribution method. We fine-tune Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) with LoRA using the HuggingFace Transformers ( Wolf et al., 2020 ) and PEFT ( Mangrulkar et al., 2022 ) libraries on PyTorch ( Paszke et al., 2019 ) . Attribution jobs ran on single NVIDIA A100-80GB, H100, and H200 GPUs. The main attribution sweep took about 2,400 GPU-hours in total, with a per-job breakdown in Appendix C.2 .

such as travel luggage, fruit, or road vehicles. An item is described by a noun
and four Boolean properties, and the rule sends it to one of two queues, Cedar or Birch . We construct a bank of 100 categories; the main

blocks.en: Both tasks use the recipe in Table 2 . They differ in two places. • Trainable vocabulary. Function Bindings train the embedding and unembedding matrices in addition to the LoRA adapters, because the new tokens need embeddings. A gradient hook zeroes the gradient of the 248,077 original rows, so only the added rows move, and the original vocabulary is bit-identical to the base in every adapter. blocks.en: Every curvature estimate uses the cross-entropy empirical Fisher: outer products of observed-label gradients, rather than gradients at labels sampled from the model as in Grosse et al. (2023a) . This follows the influence-function derivation: the curvature linearizes the stationarity condition of the training objective, which is cross-entropy in our experiments. Thus, changing the scoring loss changes the query and document gradients, but not the curvature estimate. We use the following damping values: • EK-FAC uses an absolute δ = 10 − 12 \delta=10^{-12} , i.e. effectively none. Its Kronecker factors are estimated over tokens (about 130,000 positions on the reference cell), so they are well determined. • LoGra and TrackStar add a ridge of 10 − 3 10^{-3} times each 256 × 256 256\times 256 block’s mean diagonal. Block scales vary by orders of magnitude across depth, so a fixed absolute ridge would dominate some blocks and be negligible in others. • TRAK adds 10 − 6 10^{-6} times the mean diagonal of its M × M M\times M Gram matrix. • SOURCE uses no damping (Section A.2 ).

blocks.en: Every job records its own wall-clock time, from model load to written scores (the adapter download and the upload are excluded). Each job had one GPU to itself: a worker started a job only on a card with at least 75 GB free. Up to eight jobs shared a host’s CPU memory and PCIe bus. A job covers every method in its group and both training variants, so its time is the cost of producing every result for that group, not of one method in isolation.
blocks.zh: 每份工作都会记录自己的墙钟时间,从模型负载到写分(适配器下载和上传被排除在外). 每份工作都有一个GPU给自己:一个工人只用至少75GB免费的卡片开始工作. 多达8个工作共享了主机的CPU内存和PCIe总线. 一项工作涵盖小组中的每一种方法以及两种培训变体,因此其时间是为小组产生每一种结果的成本,而不是孤立地使用一种方法。

blocks.en: The sweep ran on a mix of A100-80GB, H100 and H200 machines, and a job’s record does not say which. Medians over the sweep’s records therefore mix hardware, and on our data the mix is not random. On the A100 host alone, the two cost the same per document. For a like-for-like comparison, Table 8 and Figure 9 a use only the | ℱ | = 50 |\mathcal{F}|=50 jobs that ran on our 8 × \times A100-80GB host, whose logs keep every attempt (the A100 jobs column). Most EK-FAC and layerwise-project cells were first scored there without per-token terms and re-scored with them elsewhere. We therefore report the two configurations as separate rows, using the job’s log to tell them apart. Where the sweep ran a job at some M M but not on the A100 host, the table gives a linear fit (fixed plus per-document cost) to that row’s A100 jobs, in parentheses. Across all three values of | ℱ | |\mathcal{F}| , the sweep recorded 2,426 GPU-hours over 843 jobs on mixed hardware (the last two columns of Table 8 and Figure 9 b): 500 GPU-hours over 296 jobs at | ℱ | = 25 |\mathcal{F}|=25 , 1,076 over 296 at | ℱ | = 50 |\mathcal{F}|=50 , and 850 over 251 at | ℱ | = 100 |\mathcal{F}|=100 . blocks.en: Table 9 separates the effects of corpus size and per-token computation. The first two columns hold the score configuration fixed while increasing M M ; the last two hold M = 2,500 M=2{,}500 fixed while adding per-token terms. Because the M = 2,500 M=2{,}500 no-terms jobs were not run for every method, parenthesized entries are linear estimates from the measured no-terms jobs at M ∈ { 50,250,500 } M\in\{50,250,500\} . • EK-FAC. Fitting the factors is the smaller part of the job: 46 of 209 minutes at M = 500 M=500 on Function Bindings (longer than the 2.9 h median pooled over tasks), and 174 of 1,286 minutes at M = 2,500 M=2{,}500 . Most of the time goes into scoring. Each document needs a full 130M-parameter per-sample gradient, a rotation into the eigenbasis of 496 modules, and a contraction of its per-position hook factors against the 200 held query blocks. At M = 2,500 M=2{,}500 , the contraction took 374 of the 556 minutes per variant and the rotation 76. The eigenbasis (51.5 GB) did not fit in free GPU memory beside the scoring buffers, so it stayed in host memory and was re-read for every batch. • Layerwise-project job. Its methods avoid all three costs. A document costs one batched backward pass plus a k × k k\times k contraction per module, and the solves over M × M M\times M or 256 × 256 256\times 256 matrices take seconds. The price is the second pass over the corpus for the per-token terms of methods whose query operator needs the projected training gradients. At M = 2,500 M=2{,}500 , that pass took 107 of the 217 minutes in the stages shown. • Dense TRAK. It is the cheapest gradient method because it computes neither curvature nor per-token terms. Its cost is one training pass with the dense projection: 12 minutes at M = 500 M=500 , 61 at M = 2,500 M=2{,}500 . • Trajectory methods. Layerwise TracIn costs one pass per checkpoint and variant: 20 minutes per checkpoint on the reference cell, and 104 at M = 2,500 M=2{,}500 with per-token terms. SOURCE’s stages are the same. Exact TracIn and TracIn-Cos cost slightly more because they contract full gradients instead of layerwise projections.

blocks.en: This appendix reports the numbers behind the main-text figures for every method and variant, repeats the main-text figures that show a single setting on the other settings (Section D.5 ), and summarizes the single-setting score and token analyses on the other tasks (Section D.4 ). blocks.en: The per-token terms of a method give many document scores at no extra cost (Section 2.3 ). Table 14 reports Recall@ N N for each of them. The CE columns are the full-document mean and sum and the top- k k means. The log-odds columns are: • the full-document mean, which is the gradient of L lo L_{\mathrm{lo}} ; • the full-document sum; • the mean weighted by Q = 1 − p ¯ Q=1-\bar{p} , which is TRAK’s recipe applied to every method; • the top- k k means. Four observations follow. • The loss matters before pooling. On the two Function Bindings tasks, top- k k pooling of the CE terms recovers EK-FAC (from 0.59 to 0.89, and from 0.06 to 0.87) but leaves every other method at 0.22 or below. Switching to log-odds terms lifts every method on Function Bindings, even without pooling. • The full-document mean favors short documents. With distractors, the full-document mean fails under either loss (Grad-Dot 0.00 and EK-FAC 0.06 under CE, 0.05 and 0.18 under log-odds), while the log-odds sum succeeds (0.85 and 0.99). The mean divides each document’s score by its length, n d n_{d} , and the 12-token decoys are an order of magnitude shorter than the fact documents. Top- k k pooling does not depend on length when k k is below the shortest document, and it gives the best score on most rows. • Q Q collapses every method on distractors. Weighting by 1 − p ¯ 1-\bar{p} drops every method to 0.02 or below with distractors, because the poorly fit decoys receive the largest weights. On the clean tasks, Q Q costs between 0.00 and 0.10. • TrackStar is the exception with distractors. Its top-10 score (0.13) is below its full-document mean (0.18). Its score carries its own document weight, the inverse whitened norm 1 / ∥ R − 1 / 2 ϕ ∥ 1/\lVert R^{-1/2}\phi\rVert (Section A.2 ), which top- k k pooling does not remove. We expect that weight to be large for short documents, which would explain the result, but we have not verified this directly.

blocks.en: The training corpus consists of 1,560,453 masked examples drawn from 484,408 TREx abstract sentences, and the queries are 31,479 cloze-style facts, each annotated with its proponents : the training examples that state the fact. We fine-tune mT5-small (300M parameters) as a sequence-to-sequence model for 60,000 steps (Adafactor, constant learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , batch size 128, inputs truncated to 256 tokens and targets to 32; seed 1001). blocks.en: Table 16 gives the values plotted in Figure 7 , together with the remaining variants of each method. Four observations qualify the main-text result: • The loss change helps every method; top-10 selection is roughly neutral. Paired by seed at B = 11,522 B=11{,}522 , negative log-odds adds 32 ± 3 32\pm 3 points to TRAK, 15 ± 1 15\pm 1 to EK-FAC, and 16 ± 3 16\pm 3 to Grad-Dot. Under negative log-odds, keeping only the top 10 tokens adds 2 to 4 points to EK-FAC at every budget and changes Grad-Dot by − 6 -6 to + 3 +3 . • Removing the annotated proponents matters little. Removing every ground-truth proponent drops accuracy on the 50 facts by only 9 points. Removing BM25’s selection, which contains 76% of the proponents, drops it by 15 points, less than removing the selections of TRAK, EK-FAC, or Grad-Dot under negative log-odds. Park et al. (2023) found the same on FTRACE-TREX: BM25 retrieves the proponents far better than TRAK, yet removing TRAK’s top-ranked documents lowers accuracy more. The documents that matter to the retrained model are largely not the annotated ones. • Larger accuracy drops come with forgetting of collateral facts. The negative-log-odds rankings also lower accuracy on other facts of the same relations, by 8 (Grad-Dot) to 15 (EK-FAC) points. Their highest-ranked documents include ones that teach a relation’s answer pattern, not only one fact’s evidence. The drop on the 50 facts is still about three times this collateral, and facts in other relations are unaffected.
